title: Select a retained FULL request in Engram's launcher with --request-message-id
outcome: Engram's launcher can select one native or relayed retained FULL request and refuses execution until the existing host registration readback confirms the exact selected request message.
acceptance: Only full mode accepts --request-message-id with a valid native or relay-message spelling; focused and standalone selection are refused before any stage executes.
The field is included in immutable registration identity only when present; no-flag legacy request identity remains unchanged.

Before executing a selected request, the existing exact GET readback must contain run.requestMessageId === request.requestMessageId; an old host that ignores it and a mismatched or missing echo refuse execution without a standalone fallback.

Tests cover present, absent, matched, missing, mismatched and malformed request selectors and detached execution using existing launcher/registration owners; focused checks and the normal review and landing requirements pass.
Docs state the K3 dependency and distinguish fixture/parity proof from end-to-end proof; no end-to-end claim is made until K3 actually ships and a real run demonstrates it.

completion.summary: Landed the retained FULL request selector on master at 90d2fec7215ce041c6d74f8e20056b9ecdcb0d39, pushed and installed. Selector tests and exact-candidate full gate passed; the full run's registration remained unconfirmed, so it does not provide host-check credit.
